description:
Block (server-side) until the scope has no pending/running jobs, or the
    timeout passes — use this instead of polling get_workflow_status yourself.
    Returns {done, jobs}. If done=false the work is still running: just call
    await_jobs again (a 3-5 minute storyboard takes a few consecutive calls).
    Keep timeout_seconds <= 50 so the client doesn't time out the tool call.

project_id.description: Project ID whose jobs to wait for; pass exactly one of project_id or style_id
project_id.title: Project Id

style_id.description: Style ID whose analysis/template jobs to wait for; pass exactly one of project_id or style_id
style_id.title: Style Id

timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to block server-side before returning done=false; keep <= 50 so the client doesn't time out the tool call
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

name: await_jobs
title: Wait for jobs
